high_level_description: This image captures a beautifully presented breakfast dish served on a white rectangular plate. The main focus is a stack of three pancakes, garnished with fresh blueberries, a dollop of whipped cream, and a sprig of mint. The pancakes are drizzled with chocolate sauce, adding a rich contrast to the light color of the pancakes. Surrounding the pancakes are scattered nuts and seeds, enhancing the visual appeal and suggesting a crunchy texture. There are also two small black bowls containing what appears to be a creamy sauce and possibly a syrup or another type of condiment.
